Author: OhKannaDuh (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath)
Name: Occult Helper
Description:
OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: occulthelper (alias: och)
  /occulthelper → Opens the main window
  /occulthelper config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /occulthelper config list → Lists config keys
  /occulthelper config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /occulthelper config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /occulthelper buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /occulthelper tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /occulthelper illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /occulthelper reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /occulthelper (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)
Punchline: OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
